problem: Important AI pages remained discoverable from product content but were missing from the canonical global Kennis navigation and footer; overlapping route recovery also left duplicate rewrites on main.
root_cause: Product-level discovery was restored before the canonical shell source was updated, while concurrent route recovery merged the same clean-route rules twice.
decision: Make AI Modelwijzer and AI Governance canonical navigation entries in desktop, mobile and footer; keep component mirrors aligned; enforce unique conversion rewrites.
prevention: AI Modelwijzer and AI Governance remain globally discoverable from the canonical Kennis navigation.
Canonical shell source and header/footer component mirrors must carry the same global destinations.
Conversion-critical Netlify rewrite rules must be unique.
